mapper.select: SELECT pmc.id as methodId, cc.code as methodCode, pmc.name as methodName, ma.url as imageUrl, pmc.description as description, pmc.active as active, pmc.sort_no as sortNo from pay_method_cfg pmc join common_code cc onF pmc.method_id = cc.id join media_asset ma on pmc.image_asset_id = ma.id
